name: Helm of Aurora Borealis
body:
Price 125,000 gp; Slot head; CL 13th; Weight 3 lbs.; Aura strong varied

DESCRIPTION

The helm of aurora borealis is similar to a helm of brilliance, except its spells focus on cold rather than fire. Other aspects of the helm, such as detecting and damaging undead, remain unchanged. The helm has 10 blue topazes that can be used for freezing sphere, 20 aquamarines that can be used for wall of ice, 30 tanzanites that can be used for flurry of snowball, and 40 opals that can be used for daylight. In addition, the wearer gains resistance to cold 30 and his weapons become frost weapons instead of flaming weapons.

Note: This item is variant of the helm of brilliance.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 62,500 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells daylight, detect undead, flurry of snowball, freezing sphere, holy ice weapon, protection from energy, wall of ice
